commit_message:
[Codegen][SPIRV] Add Broadcom VideoCore VII GPU target (#24541)

Adds a SPIR-V code generation target for the Broadcom VideoCore VII GPU.
The GPU can be found in the Raspberry Pi 5.

The reason why we should have a dedicated configuration, rather than
falling back to the default SPIRV config, is that is allows us to tune
the tiling heuristic to better match the architecture of the Broadcom
GPU.

Only `f32` matmul/batch-matmul tilings are tuned. Convolutions and other
element types fall back to the generic SPIR-V config for now. Follow-up
PRs will extend the heuristics to support these. Initial performance
numbers will also be given in follow-up PRs. Here we simply set it up.
name: sdxl/clip_benchmark_cpu.json
